purpose: The fault that killed mediaserverd when a photograph was taken (run q10ia) and at every restart after it, leaving the viewfinder black. libredwoodair.dylib only; Nord2Metal stays the installed y2s43 one. Cause: after a compute dispatch the library asked Panfrost to unbind its image slots with a NULL list, count 0 and the slots as 'trailing'; Panfrost then drops the resources but clears no bit of its image mask (pan_context.c:268-276), and the next kernel with fewer image slots (the still image converter's VideoToolbox kernel after the viewfinder's) was drawn with a mask bit over a NULL resource: SIGSEGV at 0x4c in util_image_to_sampler_view. Fix: the unbind is asked with a count, and every bind also unbinds the slots above its own that the stage last had. Previous file kept as /private/var/db/nord2-metal/libredwoodair.dylib.pre-vt5; receipt.json inventory updated. Undo: guest-vt5-undo.sh.
